newsitem.title: CROATIA: PRESS DIGEST - Croatian weekly - July 30.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Croatian weekly - July 30.

text.p: Following are the main stroies in Croatian weekly Nacional. Reuters has not verified them nor does it vouch for their accuracy.
- A special police force takes part in arresting Croatian Army general Ivan Korade, 33, who refused to accept early retirement and ordered his 7th brigade to march on the capital.

- U.S. Assistant State Secretary John Shattuck is proposing Croatia for candidacy to NATO membership in 1999, says Social democrat Zdravko Tomac, who heads of one of the leading opposition parties SDP.

- NATO forces stir fears among Bosnian Croats by launching a surprise operation that resulted in the capture of the Hague war crimes tribunal indictee Fritz Franz Gabriel. An Austrian citizen, allegedly wanted at home for drug trafficking, Gabriel was earlier reported to have voluntarily surrendered to the court.

- Interview with human rights activist Bianca Jagger, ex-wife of Mick Jagger of the Rolling Stones: "Horrors of Srebrenica are beyond compare. (UN's) Akashi, Bildt and French general Janvier are responsible and should also be put on trial in the Hague." -- Zagreb newsroom, +385 1 455 7075
